title: OpenAI employee arrested for planting a recording device

summary: An OpenAI engineer has been arrested after management discovered a hidden recording device in a conference room. The suspect, identified as Abdulrahman Alfozan, faces federal charges.
whatHappened: OpenAI discovered a sophisticated recording device hidden in one of its conference rooms. Following the discovery, a 35-year-old Saudi national and OpenAI employee named Abdulrahman Alfozan was arrested and charged with using or endeavoring to use a device to intercept oral communications.
importantDetails: OpenAI discovered a hidden recording device in an office
An employee named Abdulrahman Alfozan was arrested
Alfozan is charged with intercepting oral communications
Department of Justice issued a press release on the charges
